note: This registry is the authoritative description of the queryable surface. Anything not listed here is out of scope for generated queries, even if it exists in the database.

conventions.ownership_units: Ownership is stored in basis points as an integer property named bps. 10000 bps equals 100 percent. There is no percentage property.
conventions.monetary_units: Monetary values are integers in minor units of the currency named in the sibling currency property. There is no decimal amount property.
conventions.validity: Relationships carrying valid_from and valid_to are effective-dated. valid_to null means currently in force. Any as-of query must constrain both bounds.
conventions.identity: Entities are identified by entity_uid. legal_name is not unique and is not an identifier.

not_represented: credit facilities, loan balances, arrears and any bank or finance company record
sanctions and politically exposed person status
valuations other than the single appraised_value_minor on AssetUnit
any relationship between a natural person and an asset that is not mediated by an entity or an instrument
